source: Author requested a husk hat, October 16, 2026. Local practical clothing proposal governed by Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md. Shaped shell construction avoids ordinary cloth and does not assume easy husk-fiber textile manufacture.
scope: One separate Clothing item. No runtime equipment slot, world placement, streaming, saved-game changes or protection statistics.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Booter-worn hat concept; fit, packing and canister clearance unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed shell-working craft or trade; availability and price unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate shaping and joining of selected thin husk-shell segments, smoothed edges and small metal fasteners. No wood, ordinary cloth or full textile process required by this design; exact inputs, joining and production remain unresolved.
defaults.Limitations: Clothing, not a helmet. Fit, shade coverage, wind retention, wear and comfort remain proposals. No armor, storm resistance, electrical insulation, survival bonus or new equipment slot established.
defaults.Classification basis: Author-requested practical husk hat, separately listed from the elaborate husk-fiber fashion headdress and specialized headwear.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 finished hat using selected, qualified T1 shell stock and supporting fittings. Exact preparation and construction remain unresolved.

items.name: Husk hat
items.purpose: A plain low-crowned hat made from thin overlapping husk-shell segments, with a broad downturned brim and small metal joining tabs. Proposed as everyday headwear with a shaded silhouette; fitting and actual shade performance require design.
items.icon: One plain amber-brown husk-shell hat with a low rounded segmented crown, broad downturned brim, visible growth lines and tiny metal joining tabs. No textile lining, decorative crest, wearer or armor helmet.

fields.Search aliases: husk hat; shell hat; chitin brim hat; everyday headwear
fields.Open design decisions: Resolve shell thickness, edge finishing, joining, head fit, ventilation, wind retention and sight/hearing/canister clearance. Abundant raw husks do not establish cheap finished manufacture or a protective rating.
